No.Legis.l‑134/Law/2001,
dated 22‑1‑2002. The following Ordinance ‑made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 15th January, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
4. Amendment
in section 17 of Ordinance XX of 1966.‑‑‑‑In the Ordinance, 1966, for subsections (1) and (2) of section 17, the
following "shall be substituted:‑‑, ,
(1) Any occupier
of a factory or any other person:‑‑
(a) Who, handles
or facilities handling cotton in any cloth made of other than cotton fiber uses
twines made of fiber other than cotton, water seed cotton or lint beyond
specified limit (more than 10%) allow any foreign substance i.e. jute fiber,
jute twines, polypropylene bags, human/animal hairs, confectionery wrappers
etc., gins or presses or allows such cotton to be ginned to pressed in such
factory; or
(b) Who, in any
area specified in the notification under section 16 gins or presses or allows
to be ginned or pressed any cotton which he knows of has reasons to believe to
contain and admixture of different varieties of cotton; shall be punishable
with imprisonment which may be extend to six months and with fine which shall
not be less than one hundred thousand rupees.
(2) Any owners
of cotton who knowingly watered any cotton not be ginned, or which being
already ginned and is intended to be pressed in a factory or mixes or causes to
mix other varieties, seed, foreign substance or cotton waste with such cotton
or who abates or knowingly allows or connives at any such act shall be
punishable with imprisonment which may extend to six months and with fine which
may extend to one hundred thousand rupees.
Explanation.‑‑For the purposes of this
section cotton shall not be deemed to be watered, unless such cotton contain
moisture in excess of the normal quantity, (not more than 10%) that is to say,
the amount of‑moisture that any given quantity of cotton is reasonably
expected to have, regard being had to the place or places and the time or times
of the year in 1bvhich such cotton was picked, collected, stored, . conveyed,
left, ginned or pressed."
